name: Novotel Bali Nusa Dua - Hotel & Residences
short_description: A gated Nusa Dua resort with a two-tier lagoon pool and 4.8 hectares of gardens, five minutes' shuttle from the beach and Bali National Golf Club.
ai_summary: Novotel Bali Nusa Dua - Hotel & Residences sits within the secure, gated Nusa Dua enclave -- a distinct property from the beachfront Novotel Bali Benoa a short drive away -- built around an expansive two-tier lagoon pool and 4.8 hectares of tropical gardens with fish ponds and resident birdlife. A free shuttle covers the roughly five-minute ride to the beach and Bali Collection shopping, and reviews consistently praise the spacious rooms, warm Balinese hospitality and tranquil grounds, though a minority of guests report maintenance issues and slower service at busier times.

core_facts.address: Jl. Pantai Mengiat, BTDC Complex, PO Box 116, Nusa Dua, Bali 80363, Indonesia

pros: Expansive two-tier lagoon pool as the resort's centrepiece
4.8 hectares of tropical gardens with fish ponds and birdlife
Secure, gated Nusa Dua enclave location near Bali National Golf Club and the Convention Center
Free shuttle to the beach and Bali Collection shopping in about five minutes
Spacious rooms and warm, attentive Balinese hospitality repeatedly praised
cons: Not directly on the beach -- relies on the shuttle rather than a walk
A minority of reviews note occasional slow service and maintenance issues
Food and drink pricing draws some caution from budget-conscious guests
research_highlights: The two-tier lagoon pool and tropical gardens are repeatedly cited as the property's standout features
Guest hospitality and attentiveness draw consistent praise
The gated enclave setting appeals to guests prioritizing security and quiet over beachfront immediacy
research_watchouts: A minority of reviews describe occasional slow service responses and maintenance issues
Food and drink costs on site are noted by some guests as higher than expected

faqs.question: Is Novotel Bali Nusa Dua - Hotel & Residences the same as Novotel Bali Benoa?
faqs.answer: No -- they're two separate Novotel properties. This one sits within the gated Nusa Dua enclave on Jl. Pantai Mengiat, while Novotel Bali Benoa is a separate beachfront property in the nearby Benoa area.

faqs.question: How do guests get to the beach from this hotel?
faqs.answer: The hotel isn't directly beachfront, but runs a free shuttle that covers the roughly five-minute ride to the beach and to Bali Collection shopping, so beach access is quick even without a waterfront room.
